component.name: NekoNetease
component.summary: Music library player with gapless playback and internet radio

description.p: NekoNetease is a modern, local-first desktop music player with a Material 3-inspired interface. Your music collection lives entirely on your own machine, and every online feature is a setting you control: scrobbling, Discord presence, internet radio and online lyrics all ship switched off. The app is built around a fast, fluid and low-memory listening experience.
A Slint user interface sits on a pure-Rust backend, with a local SQLite library, dynamic theming and smooth, considered motion throughout.

ul.li: Gapless playback via Symphonia and cpal — MP3, FLAC, M4A/M4B (AAC and ALAC), Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WAV, AIFF/AIFF-C, Matroska and CAF
Fast local SQLite library with full-text search
Browse by album, artist, genre and playlist, with file drag-and-drop
Internet radio (off until you switch it on): a worldwide station directory, your own stream URLs, favorites and live track titles
Pluggable themes, including system light/dark and Material You dynamic colour
